fields.acceptance: A testscript with a fake adapter runs an agent step to its outcome, and the fake Claude Code receives the step's prompt, its placeholders filled, as its positional prompt; a step with no prompt or an unknown placeholder is refused.
fields.statement: An agent step launches its agent through the adapter on the run's change set and ends with the session's outcome.

go test ./internal/workflow (TestLoadValid, TestLoadRefused, TestOutcomeNames, TestParseErrors, TestParseOrderAndStart, TestNext) and api TestRunStartWorkflowRefusals pass; TestLoadRefused loads testdata/valid.toml and refuses unknown-kind.toml, missing-target.toml and bad-outcome.toml (on.sucess on a command step), each with the step and what is wrong

go test ./internal/run (TestAgentPollsUntilDone, TestAgentFailEndsRunFailed, TestAgentResumedDoesNotStartAgain, TestAgentStartErrorFailsRun), go test ./internal/api (TestRunAgentStepEndsWithTheSessionExit, which checks the session records the rendered prompt), go test ./internal/workflow (TestAgentPrompt), go test ./internal/adapter/claudecode (TestCommandPrompt) and the run-agent-step testscript pass; in the testscript the fake Claude Code's last argument is the step's prompt with {change}, {slug}, {title}, {step} and {run} filled, and a workflow with no prompt or an unknown placeholder is refused before anything runs

fields.quote: an agent step has a `prompt` in the workflow file: a text template, passed to the adapter as the agent's first prompt.
fields.quote_where: the orchestrator's fix brief for change set 4 (m2-cs4-fixes.md), item 1
fields.statement: An agent step has a prompt in the workflow file, a text template over {change}, {slug}, {title}, {run} and {step}, passed to the adapter as the agent's first prompt; a step without one, or with an unknown placeholder, is invalid, and skills are invoked through the prompt text.
fields.wording: the orchestrator's ruling, made under the owner's authorization to amend plans (orchestrator-amends-plans); not the owner's words
